description: Hurricane ISAIAS Data from Wireless Pressure Sensor Network and LIDAR is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Chelakara Subramanian, Florida Institute of Technology (fit.edu). FIT WSNS (Florida Tech’s Wireless Sensor Network System) and FIT Lidar measured and recorded pressure, temperature and wind data during the passage of tropical storm Isaias on 2 August 2020. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Field Deployment, Measurements, Wireless Sensor Network System, LIDAR, Hurricanes, Building Envelope. Published 2021-06-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
